what: Outlook for further El Nino Kelvin-wave pulses reaching the California coast, for the story timeline. Expert statements, not a model forecast.

events.text: Bay Area water levels already ~6 in above normal; a Kelvin wave expected by October could add 6-12 in
Southern California sea levels 6-8 in above normal in early October (Kelvin wave)
SF gauge peaks at 7.57 ft MLLW, above the NWS minor flood threshold (7.04)
Next Kelvin wave expected to reach San Diego in late October or early November, then travel up the coast
Next NOAA CPC ENSO diagnostic discussion (second Thursday of the month)
King tides (7.03 ft MLLW peak Nov 25)

Strong-to-very-strong El Nino likely through Jan-Mar 2027; 83% chance of a historic event in Oct-Dec. Several more Kelvin waves through fall and early winter (5-6 typical in a strong year); sea levels may stay elevated until spring 2027
